episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.plot: Lee Gon mourns the tragic death of his father. Lee Lim goes on the run — and finds escape when he comes across a door to a parallel universe.

translations.value: Lee Gon mourns the tragic death of his father. Lee Lim goes on the run — and finds escape when he comes across a door to a parallel universe.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.plot: Gon insists he is an emperor from another world. An incredulous Jeong Tae-eul takes him to the police station, where he sees a familiar face.

translations.value: Gon insists he is an emperor from another world. An incredulous Jeong Tae-eul takes him to the police station, where he sees a familiar face.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.plot: Though Tae-eul finds Gon's story difficult to believe, some things about him are completely inexplicable. At work, she gets busy with a murder case.

translations.value: Though Tae-eul finds Gon's story difficult to believe, some things about him are completely inexplicable. At work, she gets busy with a murder case.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.plot: When Tae-eul loses her police badge, she can't help but think about Gon. Meanwhile, Kang Sin-jae has had it with his mother's bad habits.

translations.value: When Tae-eul loses her police badge, she can't help but think about Gon. Meanwhile, Kang Sin-jae has had it with his mother's bad habits.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.plot: Being introduced to Gon's world is a lot to process for Tae-eul, who's taken to the palace. A disgruntled Jo Yeong keeps an eye on her.

translations.value: Being introduced to Gon's world is a lot to process for Tae-eul, who's taken to the palace. A disgruntled Jo Yeong keeps an eye on her.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.plot: A potential military conflict threatens the kingdom. Gon promises Tae-eul he will return to her, and steps forward to take care of the situation.

translations.value: A potential military conflict threatens the kingdom. Gon promises Tae-eul he will return to her, and steps forward to take care of the situation.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.plot: Gon brings Yeong along on his trip back to Tae-eul. He has a favor to ask of her, while she's found something troubling to share with him.

translations.value: Gon brings Yeong along on his trip back to Tae-eul. He has a favor to ask of her, while she's found something troubling to share with him.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.plot: In Corea, Luna is set free. In Korea, Gon and Yeong run into a man who recognizes them, and Sin-jae experiences childhood flashbacks.

translations.value: In Corea, Luna is set free. In Korea, Gon and Yeong run into a man who recognizes them, and Sin-jae experiences childhood flashbacks.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.plot: Gon draws closer to tracking down Lim, and asks Jo Eun-sup to trade places with Yeong. Mail from an unknown sender bothers Koo Seo-ryeong.

translations.value: Gon draws closer to tracking down Lim, and asks Jo Eun-sup to trade places with Yeong. Mail from an unknown sender bothers Koo Seo-ryeong.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.plot: On Lunar New Year, Gon and Lim come face-to-face in a public standoff. Tae-eul opens up to Sin-jae about the other world and her ongoing case.

translations.value: On Lunar New Year, Gon and Lim come face-to-face in a public standoff. Tae-eul opens up to Sin-jae about the other world and her ongoing case.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.plot: A compelling offer finds its way to Luna. Gon's investigation into a devastating murder leads him to an old traitor and a clearer idea of Lim's schemes.

translations.value: A compelling offer finds its way to Luna. Gon's investigation into a devastating murder leads him to an old traitor and a clearer idea of Lim's schemes.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.plot: Frightening circumstances land Tae-eul back in Gon's arms. When Yeong runs into a woman who looks strikingly familiar, he follows her.

translations.value: Frightening circumstances land Tae-eul back in Gon's arms. When Yeong runs into a woman who looks strikingly familiar, he follows her.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.plot: Knowing Seo-ryeong is up to no good, Gon throws her in a tight spot. Upon returning to her world, Tae-eul realizes Luna is there, too.

translations.value: Knowing Seo-ryeong is up to no good, Gon throws her in a tight spot. Upon returning to her world, Tae-eul realizes Luna is there, too.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.plot: Gon and Tae-eul are separated when he sets out to fulfill what's been his fate all along. Sin-jae makes a startling discovery.

translations.value: Gon and Tae-eul are separated when he sets out to fulfill what's been his fate all along. Sin-jae makes a startling discovery.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.plot: Lim plots his next meeting with Gon. Understanding there's only one thing he can do to right wrongs, Gon comes to a heart-wrenching decision.

translations.value: Lim plots his next meeting with Gon. Understanding there's only one thing he can do to right wrongs, Gon comes to a heart-wrenching decision.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.plot: A final attempt to put a stop to Lim's ambitions comes with profound consequences. Gon travels far and wide in search of Tae-eul.

translations.value: A final attempt to put a stop to Lim's ambitions comes with profound consequences. Gon travels far and wide in search of Tae-eul.

translations.title: The King: Eternal Monarch
translations.overview: Un imperatore dell'attuale Corea attraversa un portale misterioso che conduce a un mondo parallelo, dove incontra una esuberante detective.

translations.title: The King: Eternal Monarch
translations.overview: Korean emperor Lee Gon tries to close the doors to a parallel world which was opened by demons; a detective tries to protect the people and the one she loves.

translations.title: 더 킹: 영원의 군주
translations.overview: 대한제국의 황제 이곤은 어린 시절 역모로 아버지를 잃은 밤, 자신을 구한 누군가가 남긴 낯선 여자의 신분증을 손에 넣는다. 이십오 년 동안 그 흔적을 간직한 그는 대나무 숲의 문을 지나, 황제가 없는 또 다른 세계 대한민국에 도착한다. 신분증의 주인인 형사 정태을을 만나지만, 그녀는 자신을 황제라고 소개하는 남자를 쉽게 믿을 수 없다. 이곤이 두 세계의 관계를 알아가는 동안, 역모를 일으킨 이림은 만파식적의 힘을 이용해 양쪽을 오가며 계획을 꾸민다. 같은 얼굴로 다른 삶을 사는 사람들이 얽히자 정태을의 수사와 이곤이 풀어야 할 과거의 사건도 맞물리기 시작한다. 서로 다른 질서 속에서 살아온 두 사람은 가까워지는 마음과 함께, 각자의 세계를 지켜야 할 책임을 마주한다.
translations.tagline: 그녀의 신분증을 간직한 황제, 그녀가 사는 세계에 도착하다

overview.value: Lee Gon, imperatore di un moderno regno di Corea, attraversa la barriera che lo separa da una realtà alternativa in cui la Corea è una repubblica anziché una monarchia.
